about: #553 (B1). #550's answer a12 moved the paste row (paste box, '?', '⚡ Analyze Game') above Import, and the check of 15 Nov found it MET. Re-measured on #553 after card 69 (the Review list scrolls as one page): with stored games the button is at 116-160 and owns its centre at all eight geometries. Gate 78 with CT_G78_PRIM_ONLY=1 runs only its primary-actions loop; graded here are the stored-games lines TC-INV-08f (reached, carries the button), 08i (on arrival, unscrolled, above the fold) and 08j (reachable, owns its centre). Breaks: the paste row pushed 100vh down when games are stored (08i red at all eight); the row hidden when games are stored (08f red at all eight); the Analyze button taking no taps (08j red at all eight, empty and stored). NOT COVERED: the Puzzles and empty-Review lines of the same loop are run but not graded; Kunal's look on his phone.

breaks.name: paste-row-pushed-below-the-fold
breaks.why: with stored games the paste row sits a screen lower, as the Analyze box under the games list did before a12

breaks.name: paste-row-hidden-with-games
breaks.why: with stored games the paste row is not drawn, so there is no Analyze Game to reach

breaks.name: analyze-takes-no-taps
breaks.why: the Analyze button is on screen but pointer-events none, so a tap at its centre lands on the row behind it
